headline: Patriots in Jacksonville and Sox fighting for that playoff seed
morning_brew: It is a massive Sunday in the Hub with both the Pats and Red Sox taking the field, and my nerves are already shot. The Patriots are down in Jacksonville for a one o'clock kickoff, and with guys like Dre'Mont Jones and Quintayvious Hutchins on the shelf, the pressure is on Gabe Jacas and Elijah Ponder to step up on that defense. I've been saying it all year, this unit needs to prove they can hold their own when the depth chart gets thin, and today is the perfect chance to show what they're made of.

Over at the Fens, the Red Sox are looking to close out the Cubs before we head into that brutal series against the Yankees. We have already clinched, but don't think for a second that makes these final games meaningless. We need to keep the momentum rolling and lock in our positioning, because once we hit the Bronx, there is no room for error. I'm not gonna sit here and jinx it, but this team has been playing with some real grit lately and I'm hoping to see them take care of business before the postseason starts.

I'm feeling like cousin Jimmy right now, pacing around the living room and waiting for the games to start. It feels like every single pitch and every single snap is amplified this time of year. Whether you're tuned into the Pats game or watching the Sox, let's just hope for a pair of wins that keep the Duck Boat fund growing. I'll be watching through my fingers as usual, because that's just the Boston way.

news_digest.dans_take: If he keeps playing like he has the last two weeks, maybe my blood pressure will actually drop for once.
